jobs.occupation: Senior Program Director, Global Business Transformation
jobs.description:
Are you ready to shape the future of Ambu's global operations processes and business functions through major **ERP, QMS, and PLM transformation?

**We are seeking a visionary leader to drive a landmark multi-year digital transformation across our global footprint, optimising production, quality, procurement, and supply chain processes.

Currently in the initial scoping phase, this initiative will consolidate enterprise operations globally using the Infor M3 ERP platform and the Dassault Systèmes ecosystem.

This high-impact role will drive the guiding principles for our future ERP, QMS, and PLM operating model. The position requires a leader who can drive a complex program incl. effective change management, simplify complex workflows, deliver business transformation, eliminate fragmented Excel-dependent processes, and ensure global standardization within an ambitious 3–4-year timeline.

Reporting to the CFO, you will set the pace, resolve cross-functional roadblocks, and hold the program, external system integrators, and business stakeholders accountable.

Core Responsibilities Governance & Strategy

Drive the future-state global process, business transformation roadmap, and operating model, balancing multi-entity standardisation with critical local requirements. Define and drive the ERP implementation roadmap to maximise business improvements, value realisation, consistency, and cost efficiency.

Lead a large global program team consisting of e.g. Global Process Owners, Global business owners, Technical Workstream Lead etc. in a mix of direct and dotted reporting lines, while operating in a matrix organisation across six VP-led functional areas.

Manage the external vendor relationships with the vendors selected to support the program

Process Optimisation & Innovation

Drive and be responsible for implementing the program, harmonising processes across Finance, production, quality, procurement, and supply chain functions, and translating this into measurable business improvements. Lead digitalisation initiatives, including AI-driven methods and process intelligence solutions, in collaboration with business stakeholders and external system integrator consultants.

Business Transformation

Lead the development of a dedicated team of process managers, business managers, and subject matter experts. Execute a global change management strategy tailored to a fast-paced, compliance-driven culture, ensuring alignment across regions and driving business improvements and value realisation throughout.

Compliance & Data Harmonization

Partner with Quality Assurance and Regulatory Affairs to ensure that platforms meet international compliance requirements. Lead migration, cleansing, and structuring of legacy data into a unified and scalable architecture.

**Required Experience & Technical Skills Executive Track Record

**15+ years of leadership experience managing large global transformation projects, digital transformation programs, or enterprise application implementations. Ideally a background incl. commercial, financial or operational leadership roles.

Transformational Delivery

Proven experience leading end-to-end ERP, PLM, or QMS implementations and business process transformation within multinational organizations. Experience with Infor M3 and Dassault Systèmes is highly advantageous.

Industry Context

Strong background in manufacturing, quality, and supply chain operations within highly regulated industries (e.g., medical devices, life sciences, or pharmaceuticals).

Education

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Operations Management, Computer Science, Information Systems, or related discipline.

Soft Skills & Leadership Qualities Executive Presence

Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to bridge operational requirements and technology solutions while influencing senior leadership.

Resilience & Adaptability

Thrives in complex and demanding environments, demonstrating strong cultural awareness and the ability to resolve alignment challenges with diplomacy and determination.

Global Mobility

Flexibility to travel internationally and spend extended periods at manufacturing sites during critical project phases. Expected travel commitment of approximately 50–80 days per year, including visits to Malaysia, China, Mexico, and the United States.

What We Offer

**Ambu – a visionary and international workplace where your efforts matter

**Ambu is a company that expands rapidly and has ambitious growth targets. We meet these targets through interdisciplinary teamwork between motivated and highly skilled employees. Your contributions and efforts are crucial to our success and by joining us you will get the opportunity to work in an international head office with an informal working environment.

We offer great opportunities for personal development. Furthermore, we offer a wide range of professional, social and financial employee benefits in addition to exciting job challenges and continuous professional and personal development.

jobs.occupation: Wear Group is looking for an Order Manager, Private Label/Mass Market
jobs.description:
Would you like to work with one of Europe’s largest retail customers and thrive in a fast-paced environment with significant responsibility and demanding deadlines?

Wear Group is looking for an experienced Order Manager to take a key role in managing our cooperation with a major mass-market retail customer.

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

As Order Manager, you will have operational responsibility for your orders from order placement through production to final delivery.

You will be the key link between the customer, Wear Group, suppliers and factories, ensuring deadlines, quality requirements and procedures are followed.

Your main responsibilities include:

•Daily management and follow-up of customer orders

•Close communication with suppliers and factories

•Monitoring production progress, critical deadlines and deliveries

•Follow-up on samples, approvals, testing, inspections and documentation

•Coordination with buying, quality, logistics and sales

•Identifying risks early and driving corrective actions

•Ensuring clear and timely communication with the customer and internal teams

WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR?

You come from a similar position within textiles, apparel, private label or a related industry, such as Order Manager, Production Coordinator or Buying/Production Coordinator.

Experience working with major German or international retail customers is a strong advantage.

We expect that you:

•Have solid experience in order and production management

•Understand the full process from order placement to final delivery

•Are highly structured and strong at follow-up

•Take ownership and drive issues through to resolution

•Can manage multiple priorities and critical deadlines

•Communicate professionally with customers, suppliers and colleagues

•Are fluent in English; German is an advantage

YOU THRIVE IN A FAST-PACED ENVIRONMENT

Our customer operates with high expectations, fixed deadlines and strict requirements. You must therefore be comfortable managing several critical tasks simultaneously while maintaining structure and control. You work proactively, identify potential problems early and take action before they impact the customer or delivery.

Structured | Persistent | Accountable | Solution-oriented | Resilient

WHAT WE OFFER

At Wear Group, you will join an international organization with close relationships across customers, suppliers and factories.

You will have a central role with significant responsibility, short decision-making processes and the opportunity to make a real impact on one of our most important customer partnerships.

ARE YOU OUR NEW ORDER MANAGER?

If you have the experience, overview and drive to manage a major international retail customer – and thrive with responsibility, high expectations and a fast-paced working environment – we would very much like to hear from you.

APPLICATION

Please send your CV and application in English. We review applications on a rolling basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

For further information, please contact Mette Birkemose, Wear Group, at +45 51509271 or email mb@wear-group.com

With an IoT platform connecting more than 6 million units — and growing — Trackunit is building the platform that will enable the construction industry to work faster, smarter, and more securely. And we need you to help run and scale it.

As an SRE, you will join our Europe-based team and be part of a global SRE organization spanning Europe and Canada. This is a hands-on role focused on the daily operation and continuous improvement of our platform, with room to grow into larger design and architecture work as you build depth.

The platform owned by SRE consists of an AWS cloud, Kubernetes clusters (EKS), and our IaC setup running Terraform and Terramate, as well as a GitOps delivery platform built on Argo CD and Atlantis.

We support engineering teams with 150+ developers. You will help keep a platform used by 15,000+ active users every day secure, available, and easy to build on.

We're looking for someone curious and collaborative — happy to share knowledge and ask questions as well.

Experience level: roughly 2–5 years in an SRE, DevOps, platform, or infrastructure operations role. If you're further along and the day-to-day scope appeals to you, apply anyway — we'll have the conversation.

With locations in the heart of Copenhagen, Kolding, Aarhus, and Aalborg, we offer a flexible setup with the possibility to work from one of our locations — or remotely from anywhere in Denmark.

**What's in it for you?

**

• International environment with regular check-ins and social events across teams, departments and borders.

• We take your personal and professional development goals seriously and we support them through training, coaching, and mindfulness as well as with an open feedback culture to enable you to identify your strengths and opportunities.

• Flexibility and hybrid working is not just a cliché to us or something we state in a job posting. We offer a flexible setup because we believe you know best how to structure your work. Once you have chosen how you work best, let us know what you need: we got you covered with the IT equipment you need for your work.

• Turning the Tide. At Trackunit, we aim to create and contribute to an inclusive workplace. And this priority starts with our hiring — we do not discriminate on the basis of gender identity, sexual orientation, personal expression, ethnicity, religious belief, or disability status. We only assess candidates on their qualifications and merit. Learn more about TIDE and other DE&I initiatives here.

**What You'll Do

**Your week will be a mix of keeping things running well and making them better.

• Operate and improve the platform. Monitoring, alerting, capacity, cost, and the steady stream of small improvements that keep a large AWS and Kubernetes estate healthy.

• Work in code, not consoles. Infrastructure changes go through Terraform and Helm, reviewed as pull requests and delivered through Atlantis and Argo CD.

• Keep the platform secure. Patching, vulnerability remediation, base image updates, and closing findings — a recurring, meaningful part of the job rather than a side task.

• Take part in incident response. You'll join our on-call rotation (SRE team, business hours) and contribute to incidents and follow-up work.

• Handle triage and requests from developer teams. Understanding what they need, unblocking them, and spotting when a repeated request could be automated.

**Who You Are

**We think you'll need

• Hands-on experience running workloads on AWS.

• Basic knowledge with Kubernetes.

• Basic knowledge about infrastructure as code, ideally Terraform.

• Comfortable with Git, Linux and Windows.

• Clear written communication — a lot of our work happens in tickets, PRs, and docs.

**Nice to have, not expected

**

• EKS specifically, or tooling like Karpenter, Argo CD, Atlantis, or Terramate.

• Observability tooling (Prometheus, Grafana, Sumo Logic, or similar).

• Scripting in Python or Go.

• Security or compliance work — vulnerability management, CIS benchmarks, certification programmes.

• Multi-region or multi-account AWS architecture.

**What Matters More Than The Checklist

**

• You’re curious and self-driven, while also knowing when to ask for help when needed.

• You finish things. Small, well-tested changes shipped consistently beat big ideas that stall.

• You care about the developers and customers using the platform, not just the platform itself.

On AI: experience with AI tooling is not a requirement. An interest in working with it is. We already use AI in our daily engineering work — including MCP servers and agents against our own platform — and we expect that to grow. We don’t expect you to have experience with this—but we do expect curiosity and a willingness to learn.

Don't meet every single requirement? No worries — this is what we're looking for ideally, but if you're excited about this role and your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification, we still encourage you to apply.

**How You'll Grow Here

**We hire at this level expecting you to move beyond it, and we've structured the team so that happens on purpose rather than by accident.

• A rotation model that protects your focus. The team splits between operational duty and project work, so you're not permanently interrupt-driven. You get real blocks of time to go deep on something.

• Mentorship that's built in. Senior colleagues review your PRs and pair with you on incidents. Asking questions is the expected behaviour, not a sign you're struggling.

• Exposure to the big architecture work. You'll start with scoped pieces and take on more as you build context.

• A clear conversation about your development. Regular 1:1s that cover where you want to be, not just what you shipped last sprint.

**What We're Building Next

**Trackunit is moving from a SaaS company to a platform built on telemetry data from the construction industry worldwide. For SRE, that means going beyond delivering infrastructure to building the capabilities that let our developers and customers spin up environments tailored to their needs in the regions they need them.

Things on our roadmap include:

• Expanding the platform into a true multi-region architecture.

• Building self-service platform capabilities so developer teams move at their own pace.

• Making better use of AI in our own operations, through MCP servers and agents.

You won't be expected to lead these on day one. You will be in the room, and there will be pieces with your name on them.

**What Happens From Here — Recruitment Process Overview

**

• Virtual meet and greet. Meet with a member of our Talent Partner team

• Personality-based interview. You will be asked to complete an online personality assessment prior to the interview. There are no correct answers and we are not trying to categorise you — the aim is a dialogue about the results and Trackunit's culture, so you get to know us better as well.

• Assignment-specific interview. You will be given a case to prepare after the initial screening interview. You will present the case to relevant colleagues across Trackunit, who you will also work closely with in the role.

• Virtual meet and greet. Meet with Engineering Manager, Kåre Brandborg and an SRE team member.

• References and background checks (if needed). If required, we will obtain references from former employers and perform level-specific background checks, if you have not provided these yourself.

• Offer presentation and walk-through. We're lucky to have you!

**Coming Together To Connect Construction

**We're committed to construction — one of the largest industries in the world. Over the past two decades, Trackunit has been pioneering technological progress within construction. Today, we are not only a leading IoT provider but a thought leader, supporting and shaping the agenda for an entire industry on a global scale.

We believe in taking a people approach in everything we do. Being human-centric is not restricted to our products — it's a way of life at Trackunit. We're proud to be a truly global team. Our colleagues get together in hubs spread across the globe, but we embrace the idea of working remotely and in environments that inspire you. Everything we do, we do it to eliminate downtime and build the most useful industry for the world.

The question is: Are you in?

jobs.occupation: Experienced Senior Lean Consultant for Project Excellence at Novo Nordisk Engineering
jobs.description:
If you’re energised by driving lean transformation at a company level and you thrive on turning complex challenges into tangible business impact, we’d love to hear from you!

Who we are

We are a leading pharma engineering company shaping the future of API pharma engineering globally. Leveraging the expertise of 2,000+ employees across Denmark, India, and the US, we design, build and optimise pharmaceutical manufacturing facilities that are essential to the health and well-being of patients everywhere.

Our success is driven by passion, innovation, and collaboration — with our customers and across our teams and disciplines. If you share our dedication to a noble cause and our passion for API pharma engineering, then NNE is the place for you.

About the role

We are looking for a Senior Lean Consultant to join our team of highly skilled colleagues in the Project Excellence department. In Project Excellence, we act as internal consultants grounded in Lean, supporting projects and leadership across NNE by strengthening performance management, structured problem solving and continuous improvement practices.

As a Senior Lean Consultant, you will work closely with project organisations and leaders to set direction for improvement initiatives, build Lean capabilities and drive performance. At the same time, you will take an active, hands-on role in facilitating problem solving and implementing improvements on our most critical projects, ensuring that ideas translate into real impact.

This role offers a unique opportunity to operate at the intersection of leadership, Lean transformation and project execution, contributing to building a strong and sustainable performance and improvement culture across NNE.

You’ll be based in our Virum Office, but the role requires you to visit our project sites in Kalundborg and around the Copenhagen area on a regular basis.

How you might spend your days

As a Senior Lean Consultant, you’ll be:

• Helping the Project Excellence department set direction for continuous improvement and Lean in NNE, aligned with NNE’s strategy

• Building Lean capabilities by developing and embedding structured problem solving, lean project management and continuous improvement practices

• Designing and delivering training in Lean tools, Lean principles and Lean ways of working across NNE

• Coaching leaders and teams to strengthen performance management and Lean leadership behaviours

• Facilitating and driving structured problem-solving on major projects, using A3 thinking as our core approach

• Advising on consistent implementation of improvements, ensuring solutions are anchored and deliver real impact

Who you are

We care about who you are as a person. In the end, how you work, and your energy is what impacts the results we achieve as a team. As a person, you are:

• Passionate about Lean thinking and driven to create real lasting business impact

• Confident in engaging, challenging and developing leaders and teams at all levels

• Comfortable operating in complex environments, bringing clarity, structure and direction

• Pragmatic and execution-focused with a great drive to turn ideas into results

• A credible role model who takes ownership and leads by example

What you bring to the role

In all positions, there are some things that are preferred, and others, a bonus. If you do not meet all the qualifications listed below, you are welcome to offer alternative experience that you think would be valuable in this role:

• Extensive experience driving continuous improvement and lean transformations in complex organisations

• Proven ability to lead and implement change with measurable impact

• Solid experience working closely with senior leaders on performance and improvement agendas

• A relevant academic degree at Master level

• Excellent facilitation, coaching and stakeholder management skills across organisational levels

Life at NNE

NNE is short for Novo Nordisk Engineering. And for all of us who work here, NNE means so much more.

At NNE, you become part of a vibrant, project-based environment built on close day-to-day collaboration. The role is therefore primarily on-site, with physical presence at the workplace expected five days a week. Limited flexibility for occasional remote work may be accommodated in line with business needs.

We are, at our core, a people business and, as such, committed to continuously developing our people and the way we work together. We do not expect you to know it all from day one, and we truly believe a great start makes a real difference. We therefore welcome new colleagues with our award-nominated onboarding programme, supported by a range of in-house talent and development initiatives designed to support your long-term growth.

You can read more about the benefits we offer here.

Did we spark your curiosity? If you’re ready to join our passion, let’s hear from you.

Deadline of application is 13th November 2026

Questions before applying? Send us a quick text to arrange a convenient time to chat. Please Contact Director Daniel Iwarsson at +45 3075 7823 or Principal Consultant, Mikkel Bonne at +45 3191 8723 between 12.00-15.00 (12 AM-3 PM) on weekdays.

Please note:

• We only accept applications submitted through our online recruitment system

• You do not need to attach a cover letter, but please include a few sentences about why you are applying in your resume or CV

• We invite to interviews on a running basis.

Fair hiring:

At NNE, we are committed to an inclusive recruitment process and equal opportunities for all job applicants. To maintain fairness, we request that you refrain from including a personal photo in your CV.

jobs.occupation: Senior/Lead Software Engineer | OTC Product Area, Fintech Solutions
jobs.description:
Who We Are

For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world's leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 3,500+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, educations, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds in general.

SimCorp is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated in our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best-in-class solutions to our clients.

While striving to deliver client value, we believe it is vital to consider our people and our planet in every business decision we make. Acting responsibly is not optional. It is essential.

Why This Role is Important to Us

We are looking for Software Engineers at middle level to join our engineering team that builds fintech solutions for managing OTC (Over-The-Counter) financial instruments within our asset management platform, SimCorp Dimension and SimCorp One. Our work delivers value in two major areas. First, we implement new features that drive the business forward and shape the future of our platform. Second, we focus on extending and maintaining our established solutions to ensure our clients’ operations remain uninterrupted and always available.

What You Will Be Responsible For

• 
Designing, building, and extending existing solutions and APIs for our OTC asset management product, delivering value to customers incrementally.

• 
Working primarily in C#. Our codebase also includes OCaml and APL therefore prior experience with these languages is a strong plus.

• 
Understanding, refactoring and modernizing our legacy codebase without disrupting the business it supports.

• 
Focusing on the systems as a whole and being able address fundamental changes that improves the quality, performance and user experience.

• 
Collaborating closely with your product owner to refine requirements, clarify business needs, and shape how features get built.

• 
Working as part of a team of skilled engineers — pairing, reviewing code, and sharing ownership of the solution with fellow engineers.

• 
Following good engineering practice: clean code, automated testing, and CI/CD.

• 
Building, extending and consuming REST APIs.

• 
Communicating clearly with both technical and business stakeholders.

• 
Continuously learning — and helping the team and product grow with you.

Required Skills & Experience

• Interest in creating innovative features for a complex platform, working on areas such as API scalability, automation, performance, and operational resilience - having space to explore, design and influence the final solution.

• Solid C# skills. This is the core language for the role; your level of seniority will determine how much ownership and architectural input you're expected to bring.

• Experience with, or genuine interest in, functional programming. Familiarity with OCaml, APL, F#, Standard ML, Scala or Haskell is a real advantage but not required — a willingness to learn is what matters most.

• Experience (or strong interest) in refactoring existing code and working with legacy systems.

• Track record of contributing to architectural decisions on scalable backend systems.

• Good collaboration and communication skills, with fluency in English (written and spoken).

• A relevant degree (Computer Science or STEM) with demonstrated hands-on experience in software engineering.

Furthermore, We Value That You Are:

• motivated to work within the financial domain,

• comfortable working closely with a cross-functional team,

• willing to learn and pick up new languages and paradigms as needed,

• able to identify tech debt and help drive incremental improvement,

• a collaborative person willing to share knowledge and learn from your team members.

Our Team and Ways of Working

We deliver solution for large scale financial institutions with billions of dollars in managed assets. Therefore, our work impacts everyday of our customers operations. You will work in a small team of highly skilled engineers on whole SDLC process – from understanding customers' needs, through solutioning and design to coding, testing and maintaining our software. Our hybrid model of working includes two days (minimum) in our Copenhagen office and up to three days working remotely. Codebase includes a mix of C#, OCaml and APL which gives broad opportunities to upskill and drive your career with us. We invest a lot in your understanding of both the technical details of the solution and financial knowledge that will allow you to contribute to building the future of asset management.

Our Benefits

Competitive salary, bonus scheme, and pension are essential for any work agreement. However, at SimCorp, we believe we can offer more. Therefore, in addition to the traditional benefit scheme, we provide an excellent work-life balance: flexible work hours, a hybrid workplace model. On top of that, we have IP innovation sprints, where you have dedicated time per quarter to spend on mastering your skills as well as contributing to the company development. There is never just one route — we practice an individual approach to professional development to support the direction you want to take.

Next Steps

Please click below to apply. Applications are continuously assessed, so please send your CV in English as soon as possible. If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is the right fit, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to help you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks. We are eager to continually improve our talent acquisition process and make everyone's experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process, we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated.

We're looking for Mobile Software Engineers who want to build software that solves real-world problems at scale.

**

**

The Office of AI owns the strategy, governance, infrastructure, and enablement of AI across Usercentrics. We sit within the CTO office and work across all departments.

**Mission: enable the entire organisation to adopt AI safely, responsibly, and effectively.

**

**About the role

**

jobs.description:
The Department of Environmental Science and the Department of Agroecology at Aarhus University, Denmark, welcomes applications for a postdoctoral researcher position in developing a Tier 3 model-based national inventory of N₂O emissions modelling from cultivation of soils. The position is part of the SmartField project, which is a cross-organizational research project aimed at obtaining knowledge about N₂O emissions from agricultural fields and solutions for mitigation strategies. Additionally, SmartField will develop and deliver an improved methodology for accounting N₂O emissions at farm and national scale.

Expected start date and duration of employment

The position is to be filled by February 1, 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter and is a two-year fixed-term position.

Job description

You will be part of a research environment addressing greenhouse gas emissions and sustainability transition of agricultural systems, with a particular focus on nitrous oxide emissions from agricultural soil aiming to scale emission estimates from the field to the national scale. Your role will primarily involve supporting the development and implementation of a model-based approach for the national of N₂O emissions from diverse agricultural soils, as well as developing the data pipeline. This will include creating and updating spatio-temporal datasets on soils, cropping systems, and field management, and calculating and assessing and comparing the resulting inventories to other approaches. Scenarios will be used to explore how mitigation technologies and management measures could reduce N₂O emissions and to assess the suitability of the proposed Tier 3 modelling framework for Denmark's national N₂O emission inventory. Your work will support a Monitoring, Reporting and Verification (MRV) system, enabling transparent, robust and science-based reporting of mitigation progress regarding agricultural field N₂O emission. You will work in close collaboration with colleagues developing and testing process-oriented models, as well as with those responsible for the national greenhouse gas inventory.

Your profile

We are searching for a highly motivated candidate who has:

• A PhD in agronomy, soil science, data science, environmental sciences, engineering, agroecology, biology, or a related field.

• Experience working with models, managing and analyzing large datasets.

• Experience working with models related to nitrogen/carbon turnover in soil is considered an advantage but is not required.

• Documented experience in scientific writing and publishing in peer-reviewed scientific journals.

• The ability to communicate effectively in English (both written and oral).

• Good collaboration skills and ability to take responsibility to work independently and proactively on the project

Who we are

The position is shared between the Department of Environmental Science and the Department of Agroecology under the Faculty of Technical Sciences at Aarhus University, and it will be hosted by the Land-CRAFT Center at the AU campus in Aarhus.

The Department of Environmental Science is an interdisciplinary department with expertise ranging from physics, chemistry, microbiology, engineering, social science, geography, economics, to policy analysis. Basic as well as applied research are conducted on some of the major challenges facing society, such as pollution and pollution control mechanisms, management of land, soil, water, air and biodiversity, protection of ecosystem services, and climate change. Advisory services within these areas are offered to governmental organizations, non-governmental organizations and companies. The department consists of five sections and currently about 160 staff (including postdocs and Ph.D. students).

The Department of Agroecology contributes to sustainable solutions to some of the world’s biggest problems within the areas of soil, plants, animals, humans, and the environment. We want to make a difference by contributing to both fundamental knowledge generation and the attainment of sustainable production systems via innovative research, contracted policy advice, and education. We offer professional laboratories, greenhouses, semi-field, and field-scale research facilities, advanced computing capacities as well as an extensive national and international researcher network.  The department consists of nine research sections with around 400 highly skilled employees.

This position is hosted by Land-CRAFT - the Center for Landscape Research in Sustainable Agricultural Future, which aims to bring transformational solutions to agricultural systems. Land-CRAFT is a section within the Department of Agroecology. Therefore, there is a strong focus on climate change mitigation and adaptation strategies.

Both departments believe in equality, diversity, inclusion, and creating an attractive work/life balance.

What we offer

• A collaborative, international research environment that combines high academic standards with an informal and supportive atmosphere. We value accountability, curiosity, flexibility, and teamwork in everything we do.

• An inclusive and respectful workplace culture, where mutual trust, kindness, and professional dialogue are part of daily life. We encourage open communication and develop a cohesive sense of community across teams and disciplines.

• A flexible working environment that supports work-life balance and individual needs.

• An active institutional commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion – in recruitment, career development, and everyday interactions.

• An innovative and meaningful workplace where your work contributes to solving real-world challenges. No two days are alike, and we welcome creative thinking and new ideas.

• Support for international researchers and their families, including Relocation Service and an Expat Partner Programme.

Place of work and area of employment

The place of work is Aarhus University (LandCRAFT Center), Ole Worms Allé 3, 8000 Aarhus C. The affiliation will be with the Department of Environmental Science. However, it should also be expected that there will be work-related and meeting activities at the Department of Environmental Science which is located at Risø in Roskilde.

Contact information

Further information may be obtained by contacting Head of Section Emissions and Atmospheric Modelling, Professor Peter L. Langen (plangen@envs.au.dk +4520618369), Professor Jørgen E. Olesen (jeo@agro.au.dk +4540821659), or Special consultant related to the national emission inventory Mette Hjorth Mikkelsen (mhm@envs.au.dk +4587158579).

Deadline

All applications must be received no later than November 27, 2026.

Application procedure

Shortlisting is used. This means that after the deadline for applications – and with the assistance from the assessment committee chairman, and the appointment committee if necessary, – the head of department selects the candidates to be evaluated. All applicants will be notified whether or not their applications have been sent to an expert assessment committee for evaluation. The selected applicants will be informed about the composition of the committee, and each applicant is given the opportunity to comment on the part of the assessment that concerns him/her self.

Formalities and salary range

Technical Sciences refers to the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Danish Universities under the Danish Ministry of Science, Technology and Innovation.

The application must be in English and include a curriculum vitae, degree certificate, a complete list of publications, a statement of future research plans and information about research activities, teaching portfolio and verified information on previous teaching experience (if any). Guidelines for applicants can be found here.

Appointment shall be in accordance with the collective labour agreement between the Danish Ministry of Taxation and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations. Further information on qualification requirements and job content may be found in the Memorandum on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Danish Universities.

Salary and terms as agreed between the Danish Ministry of Taxation and the Confederation of Professional Unions at basic salary steps 4-8.

Aarhus University’s ambition is to be an attractive and inspiring workplace for all and to foster a culture in which each individual has opportunities to thrive, achieve and develop. We view equality and diversity as assets, and we welcome all applicants.

Research activities will be evaluated in relation to actual research time. Thus, we encourage applicants to specify periods of leave without research activities, in order to be able to subtract these periods from the span of the scientific career during the evaluation of scientific productivity.

Aarhus University offers a broad variety of services for international researchers and accompanying families, including relocation service and career counselling to expat partners. Read more here. Please find more information about entering and working in Denmark here.

Aarhus University also offers a Junior Researcher Development Programme targeted at career development for postdocs at AU. You can read more about it here.
